messages:
marta: FYI SA zone (south-america-1) is seeing a pile of node joins stuck in provisioning since ~03:40 UTC. Warm pool kept scaling but nodes never finish bootstrap. I think a recent firewall sampling change is dropping audit handshakes to the collector.

lucas: ugh. any flow logs or example errors?

marta: logs from the node agent: 
```
[2026-03-21T03:41:12Z] bootstrap: failed to complete handshake -> POST https://audit-collector.internal/v1/ingest 503
[2026-03-21T03:41:12Z] agent: TLS handshake aborted by remote, err: connection reset
```
also saw VPC flow logs showing repeated REJECTs from sg-fw-7243 rule.

oncall-bot: Alert: 78 nodes in SA provisioning stuck >5m, warm-pool provisioning rate elevated.

eric: If audit events are sampled/blocked during bootstrap we lose attestation -> node fails role binding. That matches the 503s. Is sampling rate change today?

marta: yes — security team flipped audit sampling to 5% for the region at 02:50 to reduce exporter costs. They also pushed an inline fw rule to drop malformed handshakes (rule fw-7243). I think the handshake pattern for node-agent looks like the malformed pattern and got dropped.

sam: Cost thought: warm pool + repeated retries = heavy GPU minute burn. Quick estimate from billing dashboard: extra ~320 GPU-minutes in SA in the last 30m (~$480 at current committed rate) if we don't stop it.

lucas: plan: 1) temporarily revert sampling to 100% for south-america-1 2) add a fw exception for node-agent user-agent / cert CN 3) drain/retry stuck nodes after 1 & 2 4) run quick smoke test. Who can do each?

marta: I can open the revert and exception PR, but we need someone with fw deploy perms to push to prod. Also I'll add a quick healthcheck that hits /health on nodes to validate bootstrap.

lucas: I have fw perms, will rollback fw-7243 to previous state and add the exception. Starting now.

marta: rolling back sampling change and fw rule exception in progress. Patch: ``aws ssm send-command --document-name "Modify-AuditSampling" --parameters 'region=south-america-1,sampling=100'``

lucas: fw rollback applied, added SG rule allowing node-agent TLS on port 443 to audit-collector (tag-based). Confirming flow logs now show ACCEPT for the previous REJECTed flows.

eric: once accepted, let's force a small restart on 20 stuck agents to avoid long-tail retries. Also add a transient policy to keep warm-pool from scaling past current size for 15m so we don't double-charge.

marta: doing agent restart on a subset now, watching logs.

oncall-bot: Incident note created: INFRA-8421 — SA nodejoin failure due to audit sampling + fw rule.

sam: I'll keep an eye on billing dashboard and alert if projected extra cost > $1k.

lucas: after ~7 min we see ~60% of stuck nodes finish joining. Remaining ones are timing out on certificate check, probably due to backlog; requeueing them now.

marta: postmortem actions (quick): 1) revert sampling to 100% until we validate node-agent handshake signature detection 2) alter fw rule matching to be stricter (avoid node-agent patterns) 3) add presubmit test to audit-exporter that simulates node-agent bootstrap 4) update runbook with checklist for sampling toggles. I'll own 1 & 3, lucas owns 2, eric owns 4. Ticket INFRA-8421 updated with owners.

eric: agree. Also let's add a short-term metric: percent of node-bootstrap audit events received within 30s; add alert if drops > 1%.

lucas: closing loop — fw reverted, exception added, monitoring in place. Leaving a note in deploy channel and will follow up on the stricter rule change during next maintenance window.

marta: thanks — monitoring looks stable, warm pool scaled down, costs trending back to baseline. Will keep the ticket open for root-cause & prevention. :thumbsup:
